decisions.reason: As the flagship transactional email service in a growing cloud messaging market, this option has shown enough promise to justify further commitment, even though the website did not show it in 2020 and 2021.

Document capture supports the firm's electronic document workflow direction and runs on existing infrastructure, so keeping it costs little while its value is still resolving, despite the reduced visibility.

Email and fax conversion still serves regulated customers who depend on fax at low marginal cost, though the long-term decline of fax and the missing website presence raise the chance it will be abandoned.
Sandbox threat protection fits rising security demand and the firm's security portfolio, so the option is worth keeping open even though the reduced visibility adds uncertainty.
